name: My AACS Plugin
author: Lumen Plugins
description: Plays encrypted Blu-rays with your MakeMKV installation (nothing to set up) or with your own libaacs/libbdplus from the plugin's lib/ folder; drop your KEYDB.cfg onto the Lumen window to install the AACS keys. Also supplies DCP content keys from dcp-keys.txt. Contains no decryption software and no keys. Setup: button Instructions.
